Jerome, do you know if the management team has made a decision about the budget for the laboratory?
Yes, they did last week.
They decided to increase the budget by 15%.
That's wonderful.
That's enough to hire at least one more assistant to help us with our latest research project.
That's right.
With all the research we still have to do for this project, an extra hand in the laboratory could really help.
Well, we have several resumes on file.
I'll look and see if I can find some qualified candidates.
